t: This is Barton Street, a street in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Barton Booth, who was one of the most famous British dramatic actors of the early eighteenth century. Booth lived from 1681 to 1733, so he belonged to the age when the London stage was finding its great performers. The street is a quiet reminder of him, and the material I have says little more, so the name itself is the main story here.
